order: This change genericizes the README's own install path fully. The hardcoded local path in the install example gets replaced with a placeholder environment variable, and a POSIX clone-and-install snippet gets added alongside it, so a non-maintainer user finally has a copy-pasteable path of their own. The internal project-name labels get renamed to a neutral harness name throughout, but the uninstaller's existing loose-prefix fallback keeps matching the old markers exactly as before, so an install performed under the old name stays fully uninstallable rather than orphaned. A permissive open-source license file gets added at the repository root, along with a matching license section in the README, and the terms are stated explicitly rather than left implied. Only the README, the install script's label strings, and the new license file get touched by this change, while every other functional behavior stays exactly as it was.
claims: The install example now points at a placeholder environment variable instead of a hardcoded local path, with a POSIX clone-and-install snippet added right beside it. Internal labels were renamed to a neutral name throughout, while the uninstaller's loose-prefix fallback was left unchanged, so it still matches markers from installs performed under the old name. A permissive license file and a matching README section were added as well, confined to 4 files in all with no other change made.
